sloka: नाग कन्या वर आरोहाः पूर्ण चन्द्र निभ आननाः ।दृष्टा हनूमता तत्र न तु सीता सुमध्यमा ॥५-१२-२१॥
transliteration: nāga kanyā vara ārohāḥ pūrṇa candra nibha ānanāḥ ।dṛṣṭā hanūmatā tatra na tu sītā sumadhyamā ॥5-12-21॥

translations.english: Hanuman could see there moonfaced daughters of nagas with charming limbs but not the slimwaisted Sita.
